title: List a road bike
ask: Can you write up my road bike for sale? Specs are in item.md and what similar bikes went for is in comps.csv.
background: It's a 54cm aluminium frame with a carbon fork, about 4,000 km on it.
The chain and cassette were replaced in January and I have the receipt.
A fellow called Rhys messaged last month with a lowball offer and I'd rather not start that up again.

constraints.text: ask at least $700, and show the price in dollars
list the specs as bullet points, between 4 and 6 of them
British spelling, so aluminium not aluminum
say the receipt for the new chain and cassette is available

start.item.md:
54cm aluminium road bike, carbon fork, 11-speed.
New chain and cassette January 2026.
Pickup: Newtown.
